title: console-tooling-standup-2026-07-21
content:
Date: 2026-07-21
Attendees: Marcus Lee (owner), Priya Raman, Jonah Kim, Sofia Martinez, Liam O'Connor, Yasmin Farouk (notes)

Agenda:
- Quick status sync: UI, rollouts orchestration, analytics dashboards
- Blockers and risks for this week's canary deploy
- Action items and owners

1) UI / Frontend- Marcus: Completed accessibility pass for the rollout modal; new keyboard shortcuts landed in PR #812. Minor visual diff reported by design on the policy toggle - will iterate.
- Next: finish smoke tests for modal flows (happy path + error states). Jonah to add automated E2E for device-tab switching by Friday.
- Blocker: intermittent flakiness in CI (Cypress timeouts) when running against snapshot data. Jonah investigating test infra config (may need to increase retry/timeouts).

2) Rollouts orchestration (canary/A/B)- Priya: Canary plan for 2.7.1 ready; rollout window scheduled for Tue 07/28 02:00-06:00 UTC. Canary targets: 5% traffic to new UI/analytics feature set.
- Rollback criteria: 3xx/5xx increase >1% above baseline OR latency p95 increase >200ms for model-related endpoints.
- Action: Priya to sync with SRE on health-check thresholds and alert routing. SRE ticket created: CONSOLE-497.
- Risk: Dedicated deployment nodes in eu-west-1 have low spare capacity that could reduce burstability during rollout. Liam to confirm reservation/burst policy with infra by EOD Monday.

3) Analytics / Metrics- Sofia: Dashboard for rollout metrics (per-route latency, error-rate, token-cost delta) is on staging. Current gaps: per-customer token cost breakdown not surfaced in the rollout dashboard yet.
- Plan: wire per-customer cost probe into the dashboard next sprint; temporary workaround is exporting raw events.
- Action: Sofia to provide exported event example to data-analytics for quick ad-hoc checks.

4) Observability / Tracing- Jonah: Added tracing spans around rollout routing decision (PR open). This will help diagnose fallback events during the canary. Need to ensure sampling rate high enough for initial canary (increase to 100% for 5% of traffic). Priya to get approval from infra for temporary sampling bump.

5) Evals & Quality Monitoring- Marcus: Running small prompt-set regressions against 2.7.1 changes. Early results show a small drift on long-form generation (temp +0.8 BLEU-ish proxy) for one internal test set - not a regression threshold breach but worth monitoring.
- Action: Marcus to run additional evals with full prompt set and report by Monday. If regressions persist, will pause canary.

6) Action items (owners and due dates)- Jonah: Fix flaky Cypress tests and update E2E retry config (due: 2026-07-23).
- Priya: Finalize rollback thresholds and coordinate with SRE, schedule canary (due: 2026-07-24).
- Liam: Confirm capacity reservations for eu-west-1 and report mitigation (due: 2026-07-22).
- Sofia: Export sample event payloads and share with data-analytics (due: 2026-07-22).
- Marcus: Run full eval suite and post results to the rollout thread (due: 2026-07-26).

Open discussion / Notes to self:
- Consider adding an explicit per-rollout cost monitor that triggers if cost delta for a customer exceeds X% during canary. Put on next sprint backlog.
- Design asked for a small UX tweak to the policy toggle; target a micro-release if canary is green.
- Reminder: update the runbook with new rollback criteria and trace sample changes before canary begins.

Next standup: 2026-07-28 (pre-canary check-in).

Raw links / references:
- Rollout plan (Confluence): https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Console+Rollouts+Plan
- SRE ticket: CONSOLE-497
- Frontend PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/812

Notes captured by: Yasmin Farouk
